Description: Second-generation lignocellulosic bioethanol using pretreatment hydrolysis and fermentation. Suitability must be verified for each feedstock.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Suitable carbohydrate fractions; pretreatment and process economics must be verified.
Environmental_Benefit: Potentially displaces fossil transport fuel and avoids open burning when residue is collected responsibly.

Description: Sugar or starch-rich feedstock fermentation where appropriate.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Verified fermentable sugars/starch and process feasibility.
Environmental_Benefit: Can convert suitable organic feedstocks into transport fuel.

Description: Anaerobic digestion producing biogas/biomethane and digestate.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: High-moisture biodegradable biomass with suitable digestion characteristics.
Environmental_Benefit: Can replace fossil gas and recycle nutrients through digestate.

Description: Mechanical densification of suitable dry biomass.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Suitable moisture ash and end-use characteristics.
Environmental_Benefit: Can provide a solid biomass fuel alternative where permitted and technically suitable.

Description: Aerobic biological decomposition into stabilized organic material.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Suitable uncontaminated biodegradable residues with appropriate moisture and aeration.
Environmental_Benefit: Returns organic matter and nutrients to soil.

Description: Earthworm-assisted decomposition of suitable plant residues.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Non-toxic suitable residues and controlled moisture conditions.
Environmental_Benefit: Produces a soil amendment and supports circular nutrient use.

Description: Controlled cultivation using suitable agricultural substrates.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Clean compatible straw/cobs/plant residues with species-specific suitability.
Environmental_Benefit: Adds value to residues; spent substrate can be composted.

Description: Use of safe suitable crop residues as livestock feed or fodder.
column6: palatability and absence of harmful contamination.
column7: Can reduce waste and support local livestock systems.

Description: Material or thermal conversion of suitable residues.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Verified physical and market requirements plus applicable safety/emission controls.
Environmental_Benefit: Creates additional circular-economy uses for difficult residues.
